newsitem.title: USA: Hungarian Telephone and Cable in talks.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian Telephone and Cable in talks.

text.p: Hungarian Telephone and Cable said it has signed a letter of intent to purchase Hungarian regional television broadcaster, Salgotarjan Cable TV Ltd for $750,000.
Hungarian Telephone currently operates the local telephone monopoly in Salgotarjan, one of five defined operating regions in Hungary.
Salgotarjan transmits via a cable system, Hungarian and satellite television programs to the city of Salgotarjan, the capital of Nograd County, Hungary.
Currently, Salgotarjan serves 12,500 customers and is targeting 60,000 more.
